top_signals.title: Paramount Draws $109 Billion of Demand for High-Grade Bond Deal
top_signals.summary: Paramount Skydance Corp. has attracted demand more than three times the expected size of its blue-chip bond offering to help fund its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, as banks look to wrap up the long-awaited buyout financing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US forces exiting Iraq after 2 decades, leaving opening for Iran
top_signals.summary: U.S. forces are set to depart from their last bases in Iraq by Wednesday, a move celebrated as a victory by Iran and its allies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Controversial spyware firm Paragon to go public by end of year
top_signals.summary: The company plans to close the deal around the end of the year at which point Paragon will begin trading on Nasdaq under the REDLattice umbrella.
